outcome: exclusive breastfeeding rate at 6 weeks postpartum
cohort: 3,738 postnatal women in a tertiary referral hospital in Gansu Province, Northwest China
finding: Factors associated with non-exclusive breastfeeding at 6 weeks postpartum were higher maternal age, ethnic minorities, and cesarean section, while protective factors included multiparity, positive feeding attitude, and high breastfeeding knowledge score.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with non-exclusive breastfeeding at 6 weeks postpartum.
